forbiddenMethods.message: Use the application's structured logger instead.

forbiddenTypes.name: System.IO.Path
forbiddenTypes.message: Use Owasp.Untrust.BoxedPaths: PathSandbox sandbox = PathSandbox.BoxRoot(root); BoxedPath path = BoxedPath.Of(sandbox, untrustedPath).

forbiddenTypes.name: System.IO.File
forbiddenTypes.message: Use Owasp.Untrust.BoxedPaths.BoxedFile with a validated BoxedPath, for example: string content = BoxedFile.ReadAllText(boxedPath).

forbiddenTypes.name: System.IO.Directory
forbiddenTypes.message: Use Owasp.Untrust.BoxedPaths.BoxedDirectoryInfo with a validated BoxedPath rooted by PathSandbox.

forbiddenImports.name: System.IO.Path
forbiddenImports.message: Use Owasp.Untrust.BoxedPaths.BoxedPath and PathSandbox instead of importing System.IO.Path.

forbiddenImports.name: System.IO.File
forbiddenImports.message: Use Owasp.Untrust.BoxedPaths.BoxedFile instead of importing System.IO.File.
